structured_output.summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getTimezoneOffset in its single file. It gets the time value via `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which should cover steps 2–3 (RequireInternalSlot and reading [[DateValue]]). It returns NaN when tv is NaN (step 4), and otherwise computes `(tv - date::local_time(agent, tv)) / date::MS_PER_MINUTE` (step 5). The order and arithmetic match the spec, errors propagate with `?`, and there are no special-cased inputs or hardcoded values. The only other change is renaming the unused parameters to `_args`/`_new_target`, which is a consequence of the implementation. The helper functions in `crate::support::date` are not in the diff, so their behaviour is unverified. Their implementations should be checked before merge.
